desc: Implement the DSU-based offline query processing algorithm.
Read input, flatten grid, collect unique heights.
Process heights from max to min, adding edges and merging components.
Maintain lists of queries per component.
Use small-to-large merging to update answers.
Run the code on the provided sample input to verify correctness.
Check edge cases (e.g., start == end, disconnected components at high floors but connected at low floors).
If any issues arise, debug and refine.
